::: {#exm-hers-outcome-risk}
#### Risk of regular exercise in each HERS treatment group

In @tbl-hers-crosstab, the outcome is regular exercise at baseline.
The estimated [risk](#def-outcome-risk) in each treatment group
is the proportion of that group's column who exercise regularly:

```{r}
#| label: hers-outcome-risk
#| code-fold: false
risk_hat <- prop.table(table(hers$exercise, hers$HT), margin = 2)["yes", ]
risk_hat
```

The estimated risk of regular exercise is
`r round(risk_hat[["placebo"]], 3)` in the placebo group
and `r round(risk_hat[["hormone therapy"]], 3)` in the hormone therapy group.
:::
